heater_text: LISTEN UP! The Ref says there just isn't enough proof on this one yet! I FEEL like the heater is real, but that's just my opinion!
ref_text:
There is insufficient evidence that within a player-game a field goal after 3 straight makes is made more often than one after 3 straight misses, beyond what within-stratum shuffling produces.

The record notes the comparison did not meet the needed size for each side.
